item.title: Urban Air Mobility and Drone Logistics
item.content:encoded:
This special issue of the Journal of Transport Geography invites research on urban air mobility and drone logistics. The issue seeks to explore how emerging aerial transportation technologies are reshaping urban logistics networks and transportation systems.

Appel publié par Journal of Transport Geography. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
